authority: Historical incidents and automatic guard traceability; docs/HARNESS_EVIDENCE_RECOVERY_PLAYBOOK.md is normative

entries.summary: v1 HELLO parser used LINE_CAPACITY offset instead of registry count bytes 10-11
entries.remediation: Use exact firmware binary_rpc.c HELLO and existing host HelloParser; real Linux primitive before new collector

entries.summary: v2 manifest.apply_sha256 stale even when indexed hash valid
entries.remediation: Builder alone owns both manifest SHA and full index, validates complete ZIP

entries.summary: Repeated v1→v4 monolithic patch loop without independent Mac mini long-RPC primitive proof
entries.remediation: No composed USB acceptance package until real native USB long-stream primitive qualified

entries.summary: v4 combined timeout/disconnect/pipe/etc negative libusb return statuses
entries.remediation: Preserve signed libusb return code, transferred bytes, partial frames, elapsed time, and release/claim behavior
Retain raw response/end domain/code and partial data on failure

entries.summary: v3-v4 remote RPC failure mislabeled environment and POSTSTATE
entries.remediation: Phase-owned REMOTE_RPC_CAPTURE; classify source only after native negative code and trace

entries.summary: v3 schedprod text 1183B in 33 frames => ~1733B wire vs USB TX ring 1024B; v4 times out
entries.remediation: Check IRQ-serviced TX drain and mgmt_tx_drop/tx_failures on actual installed firmware before modifying flow control

entries.summary: Historical child scripts printed duplicate RESULT markers
entries.remediation: Only deus-run prints terminal PASS/FAIL banner

entries.summary: AMSI-related scripts must never disable or bypass Windows security
entries.remediation: Static blocker plus native security policy

entries.summary: Git clean-candidate materialization vs Windows CRLF source hash mismatch
entries.remediation: Hash materialized ownership bytes in native primitive

entries.summary: Target USB owned by Linux Mac mini; SWD/UART by Windows
Historical early assertion suppressed failure MAP/native diagnostic outputs
entries.remediation: Artifact collection before gate verdict; test classified FAIL paths

entries.summary: Generic operator bundle guard must not grant any destructive firmware/device release from unsigned native receipts
entries.remediation: HARDWARE_MUTATING always rejects release; a separate signed owner-authorized gate is required
